name: Why Compare Structurally
title: Why Compare Structurally
description: Unstructured comparison favors the familiar and the well-presented. Structured comparison - same criteria, same evidence standard, for every variant - is how the best design wins instead of the best pitch.
how_it_works: Define criteria before scoring, gather the same evidence for each variant, and score blind to authorship where possible. Structure is the antidote to bias.
key_points: Same criteria and evidence standard for all variants.
Structure defeats bias and slick presentations.
requirements: Two or more design variants described comparably; comparison criteria with weights; evidence per criterion per variant.
standards: Trade study practice; decision analysis methods.
citations: Systems engineering trade study guidance (NASA/SP-2007-6105 style).

name: Weighting Criteria

description: Weights express what matters most: cost twice as important as schedule, for example. Unweighted comparison pretends all criteria matter equally - they never do.

key_points: Unweighted is a hidden weighting - make it explicit.
requirements: Two or more design variants described comparably; comparison criteria with weights; evidence per criterion per variant.

name: Sensitivity Analysis on Winners
title: Sensitivity Analysis on Winners
description: Winners should survive small changes: vary weights and scores within reason and check the winner holds. Fragile winners - decided by one judgment call - deserve skepticism.
how_it_works: Test weight variations (+/-20%), score uncertainties, and missing-criteria scenarios. If the winner changes easily, gather better evidence or re-examine criteria before committing.
key_points: Vary weights and scores; check winner stability.
Robust winners earn commitment; fragile ones earn homework.
requirements: Two or more design variants described comparably; comparison criteria with weights; evidence per criterion per variant.
